name: motion-ease-back-out
title: Back Out
description: Vượt quá đích một chút rồi lùi về; cho sự vui tươi, thành công, dùng hạn chế trong giao diện.out(1.7)).

moworks.author: moworks

options.graph: a canvas to draw the curve on (a teaching guide; none by default)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 100 % with overshoot: recipe ~110 % at 350 ms, 100 % at 500 ms; curve cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) (peaks 1.10 at ~57 % of the time), 400–600 ms. GSAP back.out(1.7) is the native form. Rule: playful / success, use sparingly in UI. Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.5 s; 0.4–0.6) · ease (back.out(1.7) | custom .34,1.56,.64,1).
